key_insight: RoleFlow adapts multi-agent collaboration through atomic structural edits and on-demand role synthesis, learning which changes improve task outcomes.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive collaboration could reduce reliance on fixed agent workflows for mathematical reasoning, coding, and web interaction.
method: Refine collaboration structures using feedback-driven atomic edits.
Synthesize new agent roles on demand.
Use SECPO to compare each edit with a no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and assign credit to edit-specific tokens.
evidence_signal: Across seven benchmarks in four domains, RoleFlow reports the best average performance, exceeding the strongest competitor by 4.7 points and improving multi-hop QA by 3.2–7.5 F1 points.
watch_item: Counterfactual edit evaluation may add execution cost; the abstract does not quantify compute or latency overhead.
paper_title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
